miners.name: SkyWire Forecast Verify
miners.description: Verifies a weather-forecast claim against the authoritative forecast, read live at request time. Name a place and the window and optionally a claim such as a temperature threshold or whether it will rain and the miner returns a verdict (correct, incorrect or partially correct) with the real figures or states the authoritative forecast when there is no claim to check. Forecast values come from MET Norway locationforecast 2.0 (CC BY 4.0 and NLOD 2.0) and the US National Weather Service, with place coordinates from Wikidata (CC0 1.0). Keyless, no API key ever. Serves the WEATHER_FORECAST_VERIFY intent.
